name: Volunteering
overview: Scripture calls believers to generous and selfless service, highlighting that giving freely leads to increase, while withholding harms (Proverbs 11:24). Jesus emphasizes the urgent need for laborers to engage in the abundant spiritual harvest (Matthew 9:37) and teaches that acts of kindness to others are as if done to Him personally (Matthew 25:35, 40). Volunteering is an expression of Christlike love that expects no reward yet promises great heavenly treasure and the blessing of being children of God (Luke 6:35, 12:33).
